status: Working-source focused validation, not a sealed candidate or final release proof
architecture: Ten canonical module families each own a body, roof and RGBADepthPacking directional-depth material with unique program cache keys and matching fixed shader headers. A renderer-local registry notifies every live proven owner of a failed family program. Geometry remains shared. Recovery is deferred until the render stack returns; no raw source, shader, driver or asset payload enters diagnostics. Materials and hooks join existing renderer lifetime cleanup.
limits: Current kit directional shadows are covered; no point-light distance or VSM ownership is asserted.
Unowned, mismatched or known-but-unregistered shader markers use renderer-level recovery, never arbitrary asset attribution.
Native context loss remains separately classified. Arbitrary asynchronous GPU/driver failures are not inferred from asset identity.
Counts are current-renderer resources in Chromium SwiftShader, not process-wide GPU memory, real-GPU performance or a new heap-leak proof.
Unsupported stored module IDs are not covered end-to-end because current canonical scene contracts constrain IDs before Room mounts.
